Archaeology of Syria-Palestine

Ronald A. Simkins, Ph.D.

Welcome

Welcome to the on-line version of CNE/HIS/THL/ART 350 Archaeology of Syria-Palestine. Through the readings, the written assignments, and the class discussions, you will learn to interpret the social, economic, and religious significance of the material remains of Syria-Palestine.

The reading assignments have been designed to introduce you to the abundance of archaeological remains from Syria-Palestine, and to present interpretations of ancient society based on these materials.

The written assignments have been designed to guide you in constructing social, economic, and religious interpretations from the archaeological remains of Syria-Palestine.

The class lectures and discussions will serve as a vehicle for the students and the professor to interact and dialogue through the course material.
